background: Santander UK is the British ring-fenced bank of Banco Santander, funded by UK retail and business deposits and lending mainly on residential mortgages and to UK companies, and the owner of TSB.
synthesis: Ratings are A+ on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A, all three on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of them on 12 May 2026. The ratios are strong across the board: CET1 of 14.2% and LCR of 166% are in the top quarter of UK majors, and leverage of 4.9% and NSFR of 137% are above their medians. Only CET1 has moved, down 0.7 points since 30 Jun 2025, with the rest broadly flat (figures to 30 Jun 2026). The flagged items are operational rather than financial, clustering on 25 Sep 2026 around an online banking outage that left customers unable to log on.
